name: event-driven-job-watcher
description: Wait for builds, tests, and batch jobs without polling. Save a local receipt and optionally resume the originating Codex chat once.

interface.longDescription: Wait for an authorized job to exit or reach a terminal service event without periodic polling. Record the result locally and, when supported, queue a single wakeup for the originating Codex chat.
defaultPrompt: Run the tests with a watcher and save the result. Resume this Codex chat once if supported.
Attach a watcher to this running build and use its existing report to determine the outcome.
